slug: 我最强毒士女帝直呼活阎王
lines: “孽畜！
陛下广召贤才的圣旨你也敢揭，还不速速从树上滚下来受死！”
耳边传来一声满是杀意的爆喝，高阳幽幽醒来，只感觉头疼欲裂。
树上？
他不是刚做了一个局，收割了几个老外几百万的美元，然后叫了几个金发妹子，准备在酒店为国争光吗？什么树上？
他睁眼一看，瞬间傻了。
他竟爬到了一颗树上，两手还紧紧地环抱着一人粗的大树，就像是抱着心爱的女神，牢牢的抓紧，丝毫都不敢松手的那种。
下方，古色生香的小院内，一群人正在树下，有男有女，全都穿着古装长袍。
为首的一个中年人，还正怒视着自已，眼神像是要吃人一样！
“孽畜，我再倒数三秒，速速滚下来，莫要在上面丢人现眼！”
高阳瞬间就恼了。
这中年人看着挺有气质，不怒自威，但还真把自已当盘菜了，一口一个孽畜，他爹都没有这样侮辱他！
作为二十一世纪的黑心资本家，他高阳唯有在做局的时候唯唯诺诺，其他时候该重拳出击就重拳出击。
再加上敌在下，他在树上，法治社会，有何好怕的？
于是高阳径直开口骂道，“孽畜也是你叫的？一把年龄了，再敢出言不逊，休怪我一拳打爆你的眼睛！”
此言一出。
高家，所有下人全都惊呆了。
“疯了，公子肯定是疯了，居然敢这样跟老爷说话！”
不远处，一个雍容华贵的中年妇女手上的玉如意掉在地上，发出清脆的碎裂声。
中年人瞪大眼睛，浑身气的颤抖，就像是在爆发的边缘。
中年妇女见状，顿时训斥道，“阳儿，他是你爹，你怎么能这样说话？”
高阳脱口而出。
“我爹可不会一口一个孽畜，我还说我是他爹呢！”
此话一出。
“什么？”
中年人闻言，身子狂颤。
他气的嘴唇发白，直接吼了出来，“来人，取老夫箭来，与其让这孽畜冲撞陛下，牵连高家满门，倒不如老夫亲自清理门户，再向女帝陛下请罪！”
一旁，下人快步将长弓送来，旁边还有几支锋利的箭矢。
卧槽！
什么情况？
前世，高阳每做一个局，都会去射箭馆放松放松。
他一眼就能瞧出来，这是一把牛角大弓。
这个距离，一箭射来，他必死无疑。
正在这时，高阳大脑巨疼，只感觉脑海中多了一股十分庞大的记忆。
下一瞬。
他睁开眼，眼里带着浓浓的震惊。
坏了！
穿越了！
content_en:
"Evil beast!
You dare to expose His Majesty's imperial edict to recruit talented people, why don't you just roll down the tree and die! "
There was a loud shout full of murderous intent in his ears, and Gao Yang woke up faintly with a splitting headache.
On a tree?
Didn't he just pull off a game, collect millions of dollars from a few foreigners, and then call a few blond girls to win glory for the country in the hotel? On what tree?
When he opened his eyes and saw it, he was instantly stunned.
He actually climbed up a tree, and his hands were still tightly hugging the tree as thick as a person, as if he were hugging his beloved goddess, holding on tightly and not daring to let go.
Below, in the antique courtyard, a group of people were under the tree, including men and women, all wearing ancient robes.
The leader, a middle-aged man, was glaring at me angrily, as if he wanted to eat someone!
"Bastard, I'll count down three more seconds, get down quickly, don't embarrass yourself up there!"
Gao Yang was instantly annoyed.
This middle-aged man seems to have quite a temperament and is not angry, but he really treats himself as a dish. He is like a beast with every mouthful. Even his father has never insulted him like this!
As a black-hearted capitalist in the 21st century, Gao Yang can only be submissive when making decisions, and strike hard when it is time to strike hard.
In addition, the enemy is below, he is in the tree, and in a society governed by law, what is there to be afraid of?
So Gao Yang directly cursed, "You call me evil beast too? If you dare to speak rudely again at your age, don't blame me for punching your eyes out!"
As soon as this statement came out.
All the servants of the Gao family were shocked.
"You're crazy. You must be crazy. You dare to talk to me like this!"
Not far away, the jade Ruyi in the hand of a graceful middle-aged woman fell to the ground, making a crisp cracking sound.
The middle-aged man's eyes widened, and his whole body was shaking with anger, as if he was on the verge of exploding.
When the middle-aged woman saw this, she immediately reprimanded, "Yang'er, he is your father, how can you talk like this?"
Gao Yang blurted out.
"My dad is not one of those evil beasts, and I even said I was his dad!"
As soon as these words came out.
"What?"
When the middle-aged man heard this, his body trembled wildly.
His lips turned white with anger, and he yelled out, "Come here, bring me my arrows. Rather than letting this evil beast rush into Your Majesty and implicating the entire Gao family, it would be better for me to clean up the family myself, and then apologize to Your Majesty the Empress!"
On the side, the servant quickly brought the long bow, and there were a few sharp arrows beside it.
Damn it!
What's going on?
In his previous life, Gao Yang would go to the archery hall to relax every time he played a round.
He could tell at a glance that it was a large bow with horns.
From this distance, if he were shot with an arrow, he would definitely die.
At this moment, Gao Yang's brain was in severe pain, and he felt that there was a huge memory in his mind.
The next moment.
He opened his eyes with deep shock.
broken!
Time traveled!
